description: stoa-mail uses a hand-rolled route_method (~400 lines) instead of implementing the JmapBackend trait from jmap-server and using the four generic handlers (handle_get, handle_changes, handle_query, handle_query_changes). This causes protocol compliance bugs and code duplication. Epic to refactor stoa-mail to implement JmapBackend and use the generic handlers.
title: Adopt JmapBackend trait in stoa-mail
